user.title: Nexus Videocitofono
user.description: Adds notifications and convenience features to your IP door intercom (any brand that exposes call, buttons and video to Home Assistant). After adding, press CONFIGURE to set everything up.

init.title: Which intercom do you have?
init.description: Choose the intercom brand: the next step's fields will be pre-filled accordingly. The integration works with any IP intercom that exposes call, buttons and video to Home Assistant; the brand only simplifies setup.

dahua_mode.title: Dahua: advanced answer (optional)
dahua_mode.description: With the Nexus add-on your Dahua also gets: a real "Answer" (the indoor monitor stops ringing), instant two-way audio, an "in call" state and a hang-up that ends the call at the door station. Without it, the basic Dahua stays (video, door release, notification). Enable it only if you installed the add-on.

data.use_addon: Use the add-on for SIP answer and instant audio

dahua_vto.title: Dahua VTO credentials
dahua_vto.description: Needed to configure the add-on: the door station (VTO) IP and its web admin user/password. Used only to read the model and the extensions; the extension passwords are never read.

dahua_ext.title: SIP extension for the add-on
dahua_ext.description: VTO {model} — {count} extensions found. Pick a FREE extension for the add-on: do NOT use an existing monitor (VTH) extension, or you steal its registration. The last one in the list is usually free (already preselected), but you can change it.

config.title: Notifications and panel
config.description: When the intercom rings, notify the chosen phones with an actionable notification (Answer / Open door / Hang up) and, on enabled devices, open the panel. Fields are pre-filled from the chosen brand: change them if needed.

data.title: Notification title
data.ios_sound_call: iOS sound for the intercom ring
data.ios_sound_floor: iOS sound for the floor doorbell

data_description.ring_hold_sec: The automatic panel stays open at least this many seconds after a ring. Useful for intercoms that signal the call with a short pulse (e.g. Dahua ~5 s), which would otherwise vanish immediately. 0 = close as soon as the ring ends. Default 60.
data_description.notify_targets: Requires the Home Assistant app on the phone. If it is not listed, type the service name (e.g. mobile_app_johns_iphone).
data_description.answer_button: Leave empty if your intercom has no two-way answer.
data_description.hangup_button: Leave empty if your intercom has no hang-up.
data_description.camera: The intercom camera: the video in the notification and the automatic panel.
data_description.dashboard_path: Path of the intercom dashboard. Empty = open nothing on tap.
data_description.talk_timeout_s: With the add-on, the call ends by itself after this many seconds (automatic hang-up), and the panel shows a countdown. 0 = no limit. Default 120. No effect without the add-on.
data_description.ios_critical: iPhone only: CRITICAL notification, plays even in silent/Do Not Disturb. Requires the "Critical Alerts" permission for the Home Assistant app on iOS. No effect on Android (notification channels are used instead). Default on.
data_description.ios_volume: Volume of the iOS critical notification, 0 to 1. Default 1.
data_description.ios_sound_call: iPhone only: sound file name for the intercom ring, imported into the Companion app (Settings → Notifications → Sounds). Type "default" for the system sound; if the file was not imported, iOS plays the standard one anyway. Default nexus_campanello.wav.
data_description.ios_sound_floor: iPhone only: sound file name for the floor doorbell, imported into the Companion app. Type "default" for the system sound; if the file was not imported, iOS plays the standard one anyway. Default nexus_fuoriporta.wav.

error.vto_auth: Cannot reach the VTO or the admin credentials are wrong. Check IP, user and password.
